scope: Physical asset and insertion feasibility diagnostics; not official AIC scores, a learned comparison or a robot baseline.
geometry: Exact public SDF collision primitives, fixed-link transforms and mass; no connector pair exclusions or altered clearance.

diagnostic_stage.description: Three force-actuated Cartesian slides with fixed orientation for isolated connector validation; explicitly not the UR5e baseline.

acceptance.success: Tip within 1 mm of the declared port base and aligned within 0.03 rad for 0.5 s; contact with the actual port contact_collision reported separately. No automatic attachment, freeze or release on contact.
acceptance.notes: Limits are an engineering diagnostic protocol, not calibrated hardware damage thresholds. Refinement is a representative sensitivity check, not convergence proof.

stop_rule: No learning or comparison until native robot insertion, retained grasp, credible cable loads, contact sensing and a feasible common failure protocol are demonstrated. Investigate material defects with bounded versioned diagnostics.
